name: Invico Connect
author: tdvorak

sections.description:
Invico Connect pairs your WooCommerce store with an Invico company account so orders flow to invoicing automatically, without copying API keys by hand.

Features:

  • One-click connect — approve the pairing in Invico and the plugin provisions WooCommerce REST keys for you
  • Paste-a-code connect — generate a pairing code in Invico and paste it into the plugin
  • Recent invoices table under WooCommerce → Invico
  • Order screen “Invico” box showing the linked invoice status and a link to the public document
  • Disconnect at any time; nothing is stored beyond the pairing token and the generated REST key

The plugin talks only to your configured Invico instance (default https://app.invico.org). Plan limits and invoicing rules are enforced server-side by Invico; the plugin contains no license keys or feature locks.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Invico service (https://app.invico.org) to sync WooCommerce orders for invoicing.

During pairing it sends your site URL plus a generated WooCommerce REST API key to the Invico pairing endpoint; afterwards it reads a site-scoped feed of issued invoices to show invoice status in wp-admin. No visitor data is transmitted — the connection is store-to-service only.

Terms of service: https://invico.org/en/terms
Privacy policy: https://invico.org/en/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the invico-connect folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open WooCommerce → Invico and click “Connect to Invico” (or paste a pairing code from Invico → E-shopy → WooCommerce).
sections.faq:
Does it work without WooCommerce?

No — the plugin exists to connect WooCommerce orders to Invico.

Where do invoices come from?

Invico pulls orders from your store over the WooCommerce REST API using the read/write key the plugin creates during pairing. Deleting that key or disconnecting in the plugin stops the sync.
